title: Toronto Tempo win 2027 WNBA draft lottery, earning top pick
summary: The Toronto Tempo have won the 2027 WNBA draft lottery. At 32.9 per cent odds, the Tempo, along with the Houston Comets, entered the lottery with one-in-three odds of winning the top selection.

image.caption: At 32.9 per cent, the Toronto Tempo, along with the Houston Comets, had a one-in-three chance at winning the 2027 WNBA draft lottery on Sunday. (Bailey McLean/Getty Images)

blocks.text: The Toronto Tempo have won the 2027 WNBA draft lottery. At 32.9 per cent odds, the Tempo, along with the Houston Comets, entered the lottery with one-in-three odds of winning the top selection.
Lone Canadian franchise entered lottery with 1-in-3 (32.9 per cent) odds of winning
The Toronto Tempo have won the 2027 WNBA draft lottery.
At 32.9 per cent odds, the Tempo, along with the Houston Comets, entered the lottery with one-in-three odds of winning the top selection.
The presumed top pick is star USC guard Juju Watkins, if she declares eligible.
